definition: a mountain that erupts molten rock, ash, and gas from below the earth
hook: Every time you say volcano, you are naming a Roman god by his forge.
modernAnchor: A volcano is geology to us. Tectonic plates, magma chambers, a mountain that blows its top.

origin.originalMeaning: Vulcan, the Roman god of fire and the forge

journey: The Romans believed a god of fire and metalworking hammered out weapons deep underground.
His name was Vulcan, and his forge sat beneath a smoking island off the coast of Sicily.
When the mountain spat fire and smoke, Romans said Vulcan was at his anvil down below.
Italians named that island Vulcano. The whole class of fire-mountains inherited the god's name.
